bringing back my viral CINNAMON ROLL CHEESECAKE!!

Creamy cheesecake with a graham crust & pieces of cinnamon sugar😮‍💨🤍

Comment "cheesecake" for the recipe sent directly to you!

#deats
Crust:
200g graham cracker crumbs
1 tsp ground cinnamon
70g butter (melted)

Cinnamon filling:
100g brown sugar
20g all purpose flour
2 tbsp cinnamon
30g butter (melted)

Full free recipe is on my website!!
